documents.title: Fulton County 2026 budget, as filed with the state
documents.note: Posted on the Arkansas Transparency portal (artransparency.gov) in May 2026. 93 pages. Amounts are the Original Budget (detail report for 1/1/2026-1/31/2026, run before any spending); the same amount also prints as Balance and Actual Balance column. The document is a scan; it was read with optical character recognition, and every parent total was checked against its parts.
